changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE patients DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_patients_required_fields_when_not_unknown;
ALTER TABLE patients ADD CONSTRAINT chk_patients_required_fields_when_not_unknown CHECK ( is_unknown = true OR ( first_name IS NOT NULL AND last_name IS NOT NULL AND sex_at_birth IS NOT NULL AND date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND primary_mobile_number IS NOT NULL ) );
